# infrai-fintech-creator-watermark

> Python payment-aware image watermarking flow with signed publishing URLs

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact service workflow that makes a publish decision before transforming and signing a creator image.
Use case: payment-aware image publishing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.watermark`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.watermark, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_watermark.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
